S.FORM: == kakiliman == malemeday ci Lu-ke 幸運的路克 "malemeday ci Lu-ke" "kamu nu Ba, Lucky Luke" u cacay makayzaay i Pid-li-s a mangga saayaway anisanga'an ni qMu-li-s, angangan atu Ba-kow sinmunga a mangga ci Le-nye·Ke-vu-ni pulung a nisanga'an tu nu manggaay. u sasulitan makayzaay i satipan nu Ameylika u pahutinay hinadihiay mipadangay tu mapadesay a tademaw. Uyni a mangga u cacayay i Aw-cow atu Pye-mey-cow matineng namin ku paylumaluma'an tu singanganay a manggaan, u mapalaway ku acawa, katukuh ayza caay kalasawad ku ngangan. Taywan kapulungan a tilibi micakay tu malemeday ci Lu-ke a iga nu misaungayay a mangga "bung-ce-si-cen-ci' ku sitatungusay, tahkal i tilibi. tusa ku kamu. DVD u Hung-en lalangawan tayli patahkalay, misulup tu nu hulamay a kamu , Ba a kamu atu cung-ing hekalay a cudad. makay 1946 a mihcaan, Pi-li-s nu misulitay tu mangga ci Mu-li-s "Morris" saayaway a nisanga'an nu malemeday ci Lu-ke" malingatu ku mahiniay a waway, katukuh 2001 a mihcaan kapatayan a pahezek, nisulitan niza tu mahiniay nacaay henay kaketun. u saayaway niza ku malemeday ci Lu-ke nganngan nu kunghku "1880 a mihcaan Ya-li-san-na-cow "Arizona 1880" i 1946 a mihca 12 a bulad 7 a demiad, saayaway pabinawlan musakamu i Bakow-Pi-li-s mangga zasi "S-pi-lu-ta-maws-syen "Le Journal de Spirou". caliway pinaay tu a mihcaan zikuz tu tataytay a misanga" ci Mu-li- malingatu tu misulitay ci Le-nyeke-si-ni "René Goscinny" mapulung misanga' tu mahiniay a nisulitan, hinisa pikakaduman nu heni a misanga' tu "malemeday ci Lu-ke" kacakatan a ziday. pikakaduman nuheni misilit saayaway a musakau I 1955 a mihca 8 a bulad 25 a demiaday "S-pi-lu-ta-maw-syen tu saayaway. (René Goscinny) "上. Katukuh tu 1967 a mihcaan mahinizsy s mangga apacumuden nu heni i I-le-nye·Ke-si-ni nu uzipay anipatahkal tu zasi a mangga "paculilay". 1977 a mihcaan, mapatay ci Le-nye·Ke-si-ni zikuz, ci Mu-li-s mitanam mikilim tu zumaay a misulitay lalid a misanga'. Zuma pasu "Vicq,Bob de Groot,Jean Léturgie atu Lo Hartog Van Banda. 到了1967年, Vicq,Bob de Groot,Jean Léturgie和Lo Hartog Van Banda. 1993 a mihcaan An-ke-la-mu kanatal mangga a kalimulakan "Angoulême International Comics Festival" saayaway, "malemeday ci Lu-ke" mahiniay a mangga mala u kazenengay a nipatahkalan tu nisulitan. 2001 a mihcaan, mapatay ci Mu-li-s. mikulitay nu Ba-kow ci Achdé atu misulitay aci Laurent Gerra a makakadum, tuloin sa misabaluhay misanga' tu "malemeday ci Lu-ke" a man gga. 1993 (Angoulême International Comics Festival)上," Achdé與編劇Laurent Gerra . katukuh 2009 a mihcaan, malemeday ci Lu-ke mahiniay a mangga mapabelin tu nu, kamu nu I-tali, kamu nu Ing, kamu nu Si-pang-ya, kamu nu Pu-taw-aya, kamu nu Te-kow, kamu nu He-lan, kamu nu Nan-bey, kamu nu Tu-al-ci, kamu nu nu-wi, kamu nu Luy-tyen, kamu nu Tan-may, kamu nu Say-al-wi-ya-Ke-low-ay-si-ya, kamu nu Si-la, kamu nu Ben-lan, kamu nu Cye-ke, kamu nu Tat-mi-al, kamu nu Sung-ya-li, kamu nu In-tu, kamu nu Ni-si-ya, kamu nu Pin-taw, kamu nu Ye-nan, atu kamu nu Layak. Pulung ku nipatahkalan a cudad katukuh tu 3 walwalen, u satalakaway anipatahkalan a cudad nu mangga u saka 6 ku ngangan. pulung nu nipasisilan a ngangan miazih tu nipabaluwan a mangga. 至2009年, . kungku a kamu 情節概要 uyni a mangga i Amelikaay a kawaw, kungkuay a tademaw ci Lu-ke, u milakalakay a tademaw. tibahaway a tademaw, tataytay sa tacuwacuwa mi lakalak, manamuh miedap tu tademaw, mipadang tu pakuyucay. u singanganay aca tu kalamkamay a mikuwang, kanahatu adingu nu uzip caay kadadawen ciniza!nika, micuay tu makatalay a tademaw, ci Lu-ke nacaay henay ku kuwa ku sapipatay tu tademaw "zuma tu ci Bey-li·ti-bow" hina maazih ni Lu-ke ku mabelilihay aadaen ci Taw-al-tun "Dalton" sepat a calakakaan, Cyaw "Joe", William", Cye-ke "Jack" atu ci A-wi-li-al "Averell". Lu-keay a subayu kamu tu "u sadadawaay a subayu i kitakit"Co-li·can-ba "Jolly Jumper", izaw henay ku cacay Te-kow pahutinay a wacu, kamu "u sabulilihay a wac u i kitakit" Wan-tan-lan "Rantanplan" ku pacabayay cinizaan. (Averell). "阮坦蘭(Rantanplan)陪伴著他. i saayaway nu paycacay aazihan a mangga nu sazikuzay, ci Lu-ke mikacaw tu subayu mikelid tu wacu' muculi i kaceleman nu cilal. mudadiw tu nu Ameylika a dacdiw, "u pakuyucay tataytayay nu milakalakay, miliyas tu luma' mabatad ku zazan atayni…" " malalitin tu i hekalay atu zumaay a natinengan
